steps.en: Install the library into your frontend app
steps.zh: 把库装进你的前端应用

steps.en: Point it at your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint
steps.zh: 把它接到你自己的 OpenAI 兼容端点
给它发一句自然语言指令

steps.en: Reads the live page DOM as text and lets your LLM pick elements and actions
steps.zh: 把活的页面 DOM 读成文本，让你的 LLM 挑元素和动作

steps.en: Dispatches the fills and clicks against the real page in the user's existing session
steps.zh: 在用户已有的登录会话里，把填写和点击落到真实页面

value.en: An AI copilot inside your product in a few lines — no backend rewrite, no headless browser, no extension
value.zh: 几行代码就有产品内置的 AI 助手——不重写后端，不开 headless 浏览器，也不需要扩展
